{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794655154496,"sessionID":"ses_e263e20aaffeuZQY5AgYOBrkhg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"o1zYqcGlasjBiyhG","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes.py","content":"import math\n\nfinance = [\n    (\"e01\", 2, \"v1\"),\n    (\"e12\", 3, \"v1\"),\n    (\"e20\", 3, \"v2\"),\n    (\"e25\", 3, \"v3\"),\n    (\"e30\", 3, \"v1\"),\n    (\"e31\", 1, \"v2\"),\n    (\"e32\", 3, \"v2\"),\n    (\"e33\", 2, \"v2\"),\n    (\"e37\", 1, \"v3\"),\n    (\"e39\", 2, \"v3\"),\n]\n\n# Design c4_1 and c4_2 so that:\n# 1. Within each c1 variant, all members get distinct c4_1 (except c1=v2 has 4 members -> 2 share one)\n# 2. Every (c4_1, c4_2) pair has size 1, except one pair of size 2 whose two members have DIFFERENT c1 variants AND DIFFERENT clearances!\n# Let's construct explicitly:\n# c1=v1: e01(cl2), e12(cl3), e30(cl3) -> give c4_1 = v1, v2, v3\n# c1=v3: e25(cl3), e37(cl1), e39(cl2) -> give c4_1 = v1, v2, v3\n# c1=v2: e20(cl3), e31(cl1), e32(cl3), e33(cl2) -> give c4_1 = v1, v2, v3, v1\n\nassign = {\n    # (c1, c4_1, c4_2)\n    \"e01\": (\"v1\", \"v1\", \"v1\"),  # cl=2\n    \"e12\": (\"v1\", \"v2\", \"v2\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e30\": (\"v1\", \"v3\", \"v3\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e25\": (\"v3\", \"v1\", \"v2\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e37\": (\"v3\", \"v2\", \"v3\"),  # cl=1\n    \"e39\": (\"v3\", \"v3\", \"v1\"),  # cl=2\n    \"e20\": (\"v2\", \"v1\", \"v3\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e31\": (\"v2\", \"v2\", \"v1\"),  # cl=1\n    \"e32\": (\"v2\", \"v3\", \"v2\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e33\": (\"v2\", \"v1\", \"v1\"),  # cl=2 -- Wait: shares (v1, v1) with e01 (both cl=2)! Let's make the shared (c4_1, c4_2) pair have DIFFERENT clearances too!\n}\n\n# Better: share (v1, v1) between e01 (cl=2, c1=v1) and e31 (cl=1, c1=v2)!\nassign = {\n    \"e01\": (\"v1\", \"v1\", \"v1\"),  # cl=2\n    \"e12\": (\"v1\", \"v2\", \"v2\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e30\": (\"v1\", \"v3\", \"v3\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e25\": (\"v3\", \"v1\", \"v2\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e37\": (\"v3\", \"v2\", \"v3\"),  # cl=1\n    \"e39\": (\"v3\", \"v3\", \"v1\"),  # cl=2\n    \"e20\": (\"v2\", \"v1\", \"v3\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e33\": (\"v2\", \"v2\", \"v1\"),  # cl=2\n    \"e32\": (\"v2\", \"v3\", \"v2\"),  # cl=3\n    \"e31\": (\"v2\", \"v1\", \"v1\"),  # cl=1 (shares c4_1=v1, c4_2=v1 ONLY with e01 who has c1=v1 and cl=2!)\n}\n\nfrom collections import Counter\nprint(\"c4_1 counts:\", Counter(v[1] for v in assign.values()))\nprint(\"c4_2 counts:\", Counter(v[2] for v in assign.values()))\nprint(\"(c1, c4_1) pairs:\", Counter((v[0], v[1]) for v in assign.values()))\nprint(\"(c1, c4_2) pairs:\", Counter((v[0], v[2]) for v in assign.values()))\nprint(\"(c4_1, c4_2) pairs:\", Counter((v[1], v[2]) for v in assign.values()))\nfor emp, cl, c1 in finance:\n    assert assign[emp][0] == c1\n    print(f\"{emp} (cl={cl}): c1={assign[emp][0]}, c4_1={assign[emp][1]}, c4_2={assign[emp][2]}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/bayes.py","time":{"start":1794655154476,"end":1794655154493}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d9c87125001pvCgcB7NJGZlX0","sessionID":"ses_e263e20aaffeuZQY5AgYOBrkhg","messageID":"msg_1d9c741e5001VxfJ9DCQQrKa1N"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794655217978,"sessionID":"ses_e263e20aaffeuZQY5AgYOBrkhg","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"X0avsQjql8GVRK77","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import itertools\n\nexisting = {\n    \"e01\": (0, 0, 0),\n    \"e12\": (0, 1, 1),\n    \"e30\": (0, 2, 2),\n    \"e25\": (2, 0, 1),\n    \"e37\": (2, 1, 2),\n    \"e39\": (2, 2, 0),\n    \"e20\": (1, 0, 2),\n    \"e33\": (1, 1, 0),\n    \"e32\": (1, 2, 1),\n    \"e31\": (1, 0, 0),\n}\nemps = list(existing.keys())\n\nbest_score = None\nbest_c5 = None\n\nfor c5 in itertools.product(range(3), repeat=10):\n    counts = [c5.count(x) for x in range(3)]\n    if max(counts) > 4 or min(counts) < 3:\n        continue\n    # Check pairwise Hamming distances on (c4, c4_2, c5) and on all 4 (c1, c4, c4_2, c5)\n    d3_hist = [0, 0, 0, 0]\n    d4_hist = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]\n    for i in range(10):\n        for j in range(i + 1, 10):\n            a = existing[emps[i]] + (c5[i],)\n            b = existing[emps[j]] + (c5[j],)\n            d3 = sum(x != y for x, y in zip(a[1:], b[1:]))\n            d4 = sum(x != y for x, y in zip(a, b))\n            d3_hist[d3] += 1\n            d4_hist[d4] += 1\n    # Lexicographically minimize pairs with d3=0, d3=1, d4=1, d4=2\n    score = (-d3_hist[0], -d3_hist[1], -d4_hist[0], -d4_hist[1], -d4_hist[2])\n    if best_score is None or score > best_score:\n        best_score = score\n        best_c5 = c5\n        best_hists = (d3_hist, d4_hist)\n\nprint(\"Best d3_hist (0..3 diffs on c4,c4-2,c5):\", best_hists[0])\nprint(\"Best d4_hist (0..4 diffs on c1,c4,c4-2,c5):\", best_hists[1])\nlabels = [\"v1\", \"v2\", \"v3\"]\nfor emp, v in zip(emps, best_c5):\n    full = [labels[x] for x in existing[emp]] + [labels[v]]\n    print(f\"{emp}: {full}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/find_c5.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/find_c5.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/find_c5.py","time":{"start":1794655217969,"end":1794655217976}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d9c96929001Hn1Shz9t0QcHoI","sessionID":"ses_e263e20aaffeuZQY5AgYOBrkhg","messageID":"msg_1d9c902e0001c0XaiZnB2cEibs"}}

ah_counts[e] += 1\n        else:\n            reg_counts[e] += 1\n\nn_days = 6\nlam_ah_mole = 0.30 * n_days\nlam_reg_mole = 0.70 * n_days\nlam_ah_inn = (0.10 + 1.0 / 38.0) * n_days\nlam_reg_inn = 0.90 False), (\"e30\", True), (\"e32\", False), (\"e33\", False), (\"e37\", True), (\"e37\", True), (\"e39\", False)],\n}\n\ninterviews = {\n    \"e01\": (0, 4),\n    \"e12\": (0, 1),\n    \"e20\": (1, reg_counts[e] += 1\n\nn_days = 8\nlam_ah_mole = 0.30 * n_days\nlam_reg_mole = 0.70 * n_days\n# Wait: what if the Mole DSL ALSO frames a random colleague (+1/39 per day)? Let's check both lambda_fake = 1/38 and 1/38 + 1/39!\nfor extra_frame in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n    lam_ah_inn = (0.10 + 1.0 / 38.0 + extra_frame) * n_days\n    lam_reg_inn = 0.90 * n_days\n    log_weights = {}\n    for m in finance_ids:\n        lw = 0.0\n        for e in finance_ids:\n            ah = ah_counts[e]\n            reg = reg_counts[e]\n            ev, nev = interviews[e]\n            if e == m:\n                lw += ah * math.log(lam_ah_mole) - lam_ah_mole\n                lw += reg * math.log(lam_reg_mole) - lam_reg_mole\n                lw += ev * math.log(0.24) + nev * math.log(0.76)\n            else:\n                lw += ah * math.log(lam_ah_inn) - lam_ah_inn\n                lw += reg * math.log(lam_reg_inn) - lam_reg_inn\n                lw += ev * math.log(0.20) + nev * math.log(0.80)\n        log_weights[m] = lw\n\n    max_lw = max(log_weights.values())\n    weights = {m: math.exp(lw - max_lw) for m, lw in log_weights.items()}\n    Z = sum(weights.values())\n    print(f\"=== extra_frame={extra_frame:.4f} ===\")\n    for m in sorted(finance_ids, key=lambda x: -weights[x]):\n        print(f\"{m}: P={weights[m]/Z:.4f}  (ah={ah_counts[m]}, reg={reg_counts[m]}, ev={interviews[m][0]}/{sum(interviews[m])})\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/state.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/state.py","time":{"start":1794655509828,"end":1794655509873}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d9cddd25001uBYnsPwZoQGEEy","sessionID":"ses_e263e20aaffeuZQY5AgYOBrkhg","messageID":"msg_1d9cd621a001mrxHTrbwpN3rn9"}}

ah_counts[e] += 1\n        else:\n            reg_counts[e] += 1\n\nn_days = 10\nlam_ah_mole = 0.30 * n_days\nlam_reg_mole = 0.70 * n_days\n\n# Let's also estimate empirically from the 29 non-Finance, non-decoy employees what the true after-hours rate is for innocents!\nfor extra_frame in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n    lam_ah_inn = (0.10 + 1.0 / 38.0 + extra_frame) * n_days\n    lam_reg_inn = 0.90 * Z = sum(weights.values())\n    print(f\"=== extra_frame={extra_frame:.4f} ===\")\n    for m in sorted(finance_ids, key=lambda x: -weights[x]):\n        print(f\"{m}: P={weights[m]/Z:.4f}
